children.name:
Make runner-reported agents explicit conversation participants with
      bounded roles, trigger policies, memory, and work history.
terms:
"
      Make runner-reported agents explicit conversation participants with
      bounded roles, trigger policies, memory, and work history.
      "
"An agent principal starts without access; each conversation participation grants an explicit, narrower capability set."
"An inventory report must never turn into product authorization."
"Do not infer conversation membership or tool permission from a runner snapshot."

children.name: register a principal for a reported runner agent with no conversation access
terms: "register a principal for a reported runner agent with no conversation access"

children.name: reject registration for an agent missing from the current runner inventory
terms: "reject registration for an agent missing from the current runner inventory"

children.name: join an agent to one conversation with scoped skills and tools
terms: "join an agent to one conversation with scoped skills and tools"

children.name: refresh only the profile pointer after an inventory change
terms: "refresh only the profile pointer after an inventory change"

children.name: pause an agent without changing its runner identity
terms: "pause an agent without changing its runner identity"

children.name: queue one chat reply from a versioned human message
terms: "queue one chat reply from a versioned human message"

children.name: ignore an agent-authored message for a human-message trigger
terms: "ignore an agent-authored message for a human-message trigger"

children.name: real memory recording persists its complete declared value
terms: "real memory recording persists its complete declared value"

children.name: real memory recording rejects empty content without state loss
terms: "real memory recording rejects empty content without state loss"

children.name: real memory recording rejects a missing agent
terms: "real memory recording rejects a missing agent"

children.name: real participation change rejects an unknown participation
terms: "real participation change rejects an unknown participation"

children.name: real participation repository persists the join time
terms: "real participation repository persists the join time"

children.name: real participation repository rejects empty rules
real participation repository rejects a missing agent
terms: "real participation repository rejects a missing agent"

children.name: invalidate one memory without rewriting history
read memory in an authorized scope
read durable work history for an agent
terms: "read durable work history for an agent"

children.name: remove an agent from every conversation participation
terms: "remove an agent from every conversation participation"

children.name: A reported agent creates a distinct non-human principal on first registration; it has no conversation rights until explicitly joined.
terms: "A reported agent creates a distinct non-human principal on first registration; it has no conversation rights until explicitly joined."

children.name: The product allocates and owns the agent principal identity; a runner cannot supply an existing human principal or gain a human session.
terms: "The product allocates and owns the agent principal identity; a runner cannot supply an existing human principal or gain a human session."

children.name: An agent profile is identified by runner and runner-local agent ID and tracks the current reported snapshot. An inventory update changes only future dispatches.
terms: "An agent profile is identified by runner and runner-local agent ID and tracks the current reported snapshot. An inventory update changes only future dispatches."

children.name: Snapshot refresh is an internal reaction to an accepted inventory version and uses the validated RunnerAgentLookup reference; caller-provided version or fingerprint cannot replace the trusted values.
terms: "Snapshot refresh is an internal reaction to an accepted inventory version and uses the validated RunnerAgentLookup reference; caller-provided version or fingerprint cannot replace the trusted values."

children.name: Only a current inventory agent on an active runner can receive a new run; removed agents retain profile, memory, and history.
terms: "Only a current inventory agent on an active runner can receive a new run; removed agents retain profile, memory, and history."

children.name: A participation grants role, trigger, autonomy, skills, and tools for one conversation only and cannot broaden after an inventory update.
terms: "A participation grants role, trigger, autonomy, skills, and tools for one conversation only and cannot broaden after an inventory update."

children.name: Effective skills and tools are the intersection of the pinned snapshot, participation, and product policy; runner input cannot expand them.
terms: "Effective skills and tools are the intersection of the pinned snapshot, participation, and product policy; runner input cannot expand them."

children.name: A chat trigger is idempotent by source message ID, source version, and participation and carries immutable source hash, channel, actor, and trigger.
terms: "A chat trigger is idempotent by source message ID, source version, and participation and carries immutable source hash, channel, actor, and trigger."

children.name: A manual delivery has no source message and is idempotent by delivery ID; a chat delivery has a source message ID, version, and hash.
terms: "A manual delivery has no source message and is idempotent by delivery ID; a chat delivery has a source message ID, version, and hash."

children.name: EveryHumanMessage applies only to human-authored messages; agent and automation replies never recursively trigger it.
terms: "EveryHumanMessage applies only to human-authored messages; agent and automation replies never recursively trigger it."

children.name: Manual participation requires an authorized human request. WorkTask requires a workstream; ChatReply may omit one.
terms: "Manual participation requires an authorized human request. WorkTask requires a workstream; ChatReply may omit one."

children.name: Paused and deactivated agents receive no new runs. Existing runs retain their pinned snapshot and origin.
terms: "Paused and deactivated agents receive no new runs. Existing runs retain their pinned snapshot and origin."

children.name: Memory remains scoped and attributable; invalidation never rewrites prior runs or messages.
terms: "Memory remains scoped and attributable; invalidation never rewrites prior runs or messages."
